title: ERC-8004 failure: wallet binding with a bad deadline
summary: The owner asks for a wallet signature with a deadline too far ahead, then submits a correct signature too late. Both reverts come from the 5-minute window in the reference Identity Registry.

steps.label: Request AgentWalletSet with a 30-minute deadline
steps.detail: A tool sets the deadline 30 minutes ahead, longer than the reference code allows.

payload.content:
// Illustrative example, spec version Draft 2026-01-25, contracts 2.0.0.
{ "primaryType": "AgentWalletSet", "message": { "agentId": "123456789", "newWallet": "0xB0B0...0B0B", "owner": "0x0E0E...0E0E", "deadline": "now + 1800" } }

steps.label: setAgentWallet(...)
steps.detail: The registry compares the deadline with block time plus 5 minutes.

failures.condition: deadline is more than 5 minutes after the block time
failures.outcome: Reverts with "deadline too far". No state changes.

steps.label: Request a new signature with a 4-minute deadline
steps.detail: The owner asks again with a short deadline, as the contract tests do.

steps.label: Submit after 6 minutes
steps.detail: The transaction waits in the mempool or the operator is slow, and the deadline passes before inclusion.

failures.condition: block time is after the deadline
failures.outcome: Reverts with "expired". The wallet keeps its previous value.

steps.label: Retry with a fresh signature
steps.detail: A fresh signature within the window succeeds and emits MetadataSet for agentWallet. Within that window the same signature could be submitted again, because the typed data has no nonce.
